masters.name: Soft interface tap

masters.prompt: One soft tactile fantasy game interface click: muted wood tap with a tiny smooth glass tick, immediate response and very short dry decay. Warm, clean, restrained, comfortable when repeated often. One click only, followed by silence. No music, speech, ambience or harsh digital beep.

masters.name: Card and page swish
masters.uses: Draw, discard, drag pickup/drop, hand fan, deck add/remove, story page, popup transitions

masters.name: Positive confirmation

masters.name: Invalid action / cancellation

masters.prompt: A short handful of three small old coins clinking into a leather pouch, bright delicate metal ticks and one soft final clunk. Clear satisfying fantasy strategy game resource cue. Close dry isolated sound, quick decay. No speech, music, cash register or ambience.
